after: working tree changes to the nine optimized source/test files
build: Release (-O, wholemodule), arm64, ENABLE_TESTABILITY=YES, code coverage disabled
source_instrumentation: Identical in both disposable copies: permit MemoryCoordinator and MemoryCleanupService observers in the test host, force coordinator app-active true, count cleanup ticks, use hidden window with visible=true. Other TestHost guards remain intact.
large_files_scope: Actual PurgeStore.scanLargeFiles with FakeScans; generated metadata only, no filesystem traversal, rendering or duplicate hashing; canMoveToTrash=false.
cpu: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF), user+system; percentage of one CPU core
memory: task_info(TASK_VM_INFO), endpoint resident_size and phys_footprint; not peak memory
cancellation_scope: Actual ProcessRunner source compiled separately with -O; child sleep 2s, cancellation requested 50ms after ready marker.
hardened_runtime: disabled identically for both ad-hoc signed benchmark hosts, as required for Sparkle loading
observer_scope: Initialization plus 30 seconds; one trial each, not steady-state CPU measurement
